practice_phrases.known: I don't worry about the time.
You don't need to worry about anything.
practice_phrases.target: 你不需要担心任何事情。

practice_phrases.known: Don't worry about it, I can help you.
I don't worry about speaking slowly because I'm learning.
practice_phrases.target: 我不担心说得慢，因为我在学习。

practice_phrases.known: Don't worry about understanding everything at the beginning.
practice_phrases.target: 别担心一开始就理解一切。

practice_phrases.known: You don't need to worry about mistakes when you practice.
practice_phrases.target: 你练习的时候不需要担心错误。

practice_phrases.known: I don't worry about it because I know I'll improve.
practice_phrases.target: 我不担心，因为我知道我会进步。
